question_en: Which statements are true? 1) A mechanical wave is the propagation of oscillations in an elastic medium. 2) A mechanical wave also travels in a vacuum. 3) In a longitudinal wave the particles oscillate along the direction of propagation. 4) A wave transfers energy but not matter.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Mexanik to'lqin — tebranishlarning elastik muhitda tarqalishi. 2) Mexanik to'lqin vakuumda ham tarqaladi. 3) Bo'ylama to'lqinda zarralar tarqalish yo'nalishi bo'ylab tebranadi. 4) To'lqin energiyani ko'chiradi, moddani ko'chirmaydi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Механическая волна — распространение колебаний в упругой среде. 2) Механическая волна распространяется и в вакууме. 3) В продольной волне частицы колеблются вдоль направления распространения. 4) Волна переносит энергию, но не вещество.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Mexanik to'lqinga muhit kerak — vakuumda tarqalmaydi (2 noto'g'ri); qolgan uchta fikr to'g'ri.
Asos: to'lqin — tebranishning elastik muhitda tarqalishi.

en: 2 is false: there are no particles in a vacuum.
4 is true: the particles oscillate in place.

rules.ru: Волна переносит энергию, а не вещество
rules.en: A wave transfers energy, not matter

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 4 тоже верно: вещество не переносится
distractors_ru.D: в вакууме механическая волна не распространяется — 2 неверно

distractors_en.A: statement 4 is also true: matter is not carried
distractors_en.C: statement 2 is false and statement 1 is true
distractors_en.D: a mechanical wave does not travel in a vacuum, so 2 is false
distractors_en.E: statement 1 is the definition of a wave and is true

question_en: The period of a wave is $0.25\ \mathrm{s}$ and its speed is $12\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Find the wavelength ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_uz: To'lqinning tebranish davri $0.25\ \mathrm{s}$, tarqalish tezligi $12\ \mathrm{m/s}$. To'lqin uzunligini toping ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_ru: Период колебаний волны $0.25\ \mathrm{s}$, скорость распространения $12\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Найдите длину волны ($\mathrm{m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. λ = vT = 12 · 0,25 = 3 m.
Asos: bir davrda to'lqin λ masofaga tarqaladi.

distractors.B: natija 2 ga bo'lingan — yarim to'lqin olingan

distractors_ru.B: результат разделён на 2 — взята половина волны

distractors_en.A: the speed was divided by the period: v/T
distractors_en.B: the result was halved — half a wave was taken
distractors_en.D: the speed was taken as the wavelength
distractors_en.E: the reciprocal of vT was taken

question_en: The distance between the $2$nd and $7$th crests of a transverse wave is $45\ \mathrm{m}$. Find the wavelength ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_uz: Ko'ndalang to'lqinning $2$-do'ngligi va $7$-do'ngligi orasidagi masofa $45\ \mathrm{m}$. To'lqin uzunligini toping ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_ru: Расстояние между $2$-м и $7$-м гребнями поперечной волны $45\ \mathrm{m}$. Найдите длину волны ($\mathrm{m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. 2- va 7-do'ngliklar orasida 7 − 2 = 5 ta to'lqin uzunligi: λ = 45/5 = 9 m.
Asos: d = (n − 1)λ.

distractors.B: masofa 7 ga bo'lingan — oxirgi do'nglik raqamiga
distractors.D: butun masofa to'lqin uzunligi deb olingan
distractors.E: qo'shni do'ngliklar orasi λ/2 deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: расстояние разделено на 7 — номер последнего гребня
distractors_ru.D: всё расстояние принято за длину волны
distractors_ru.E: расстояние между соседними гребнями взято λ/2

distractors_en.B: the distance was divided by 7, the number of the last crest
distractors_en.D: the whole distance was taken as the wavelength
distractors_en.E: the distance between neighbouring crests was taken as λ/2

question_en: Because of a wave on water a float makes $15$ oscillations in $10\ \mathrm{s}$. The distance between neighbouring crests is $0.8\ \mathrm{m}$. Find the wave speed ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_uz: Suv sirtidagi to'lqin tufayli po'kak $10\ \mathrm{s}$ da $15$ marta tebrandi. Qo'shni do'ngliklar orasidagi masofa $0.8\ \mathrm{m}$. To'lqin tarqalish tezligini toping ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_ru: Из-за волны на поверхности воды поплавок совершил $15$ колебаний за $10\ \mathrm{s}$. Расстояние между соседними гребнями $0.8\ \mathrm{m}$. Найдите скорость волны ($\mathrm{m/s}$).

distractors_en.A: λ was divided by the frequency
distractors_en.B: λ was multiplied by the number of oscillations
distractors_en.C: the frequency was found instead of the speed
distractors_en.E: λ was multiplied by the time

question_en: A wave of frequency $4\ \mathrm{Hz}$ travels at $3.2\ \mathrm{m/s}$. What is the phase difference between two points $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ apart along the direction of propagation?
question_uz: Chastotasi $4\ \mathrm{Hz}$ bo'lgan to'lqin $3.2\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan tarqalmoqda. Tarqalish yo'nalishida bir-biridan $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ uzoqlikdagi ikki nuqta tebranishlarining fazalar farqi qanday?
question_ru: Волна частотой $4\ \mathrm{Hz}$ распространяется со скоростью $3.2\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Какова разность фаз колебаний двух точек, находящихся на расстоянии $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ друг от друга вдоль направления распространения?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. λ = v/ν = 0,8 m; Δφ = 2π · 0,1/0,8 = π/4.
Asos: Δφ = 2πΔx/λ.

distractors.B: to'lqin uzunligi λ = vν deb olingan

distractors_en.B: the wavelength was taken as λ = vν
distractors_en.C: it was not divided by the speed: 2πνΔx

question_en: The distance between the $1$st and $6$th nodes of a standing wave is $40\ \mathrm{cm}$. Find the wavelength ($\mathrm{cm}$).
question_uz: Turg'un to'lqinning $1$-tuguni va $6$-tuguni orasidagi masofa $40\ \mathrm{cm}$. To'lqin uzunligini toping ($\mathrm{cm}$).
question_ru: Расстояние между $1$-м и $6$-м узлами стоячей волны $40\ \mathrm{cm}$. Найдите длину волны ($\mathrm{cm}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1- va 6-tugunlar orasida 5 ta λ/2: 5λ/2 = 40 cm, λ = 16 cm.
Asos: qo'shni tugunlar orasi λ/2.

distractors.A: qo'shni tugunlar orasi λ deb olingan
distractors.E: oraliqlar 6 ta va har biri λ deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: расстояние между соседними узлами взято λ

distractors_en.A: the distance between neighbouring nodes was taken as λ
distractors_en.D: the whole distance was taken as λ/2
distractors_en.E: 6 intervals, each equal to λ, were taken

question_en: The wavelength of a sound in air is $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$. What is its wavelength after it passes into water ($\mathrm{m}$)? The speed of sound is $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$ in air and $1530\ \mathrm{m/s}$ in water.
question_uz: Tovushning havodagi to'lqin uzunligi $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$. Tovush suvga o'tganda to'lqin uzunligi qanday bo'ladi ($\mathrm{m}$)? Tovush tezligi havoda $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$, suvda $1530\ \mathrm{m/s}$.
question_ru: Длина звуковой волны в воздухе $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$. Какой станет длина волны при переходе звука в воду ($\mathrm{m}$)? Скорость звука в воздухе $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$, в воде $1530\ \mathrm{m/s}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Chastota o'zgarmaydi, λ tezlikka proporsional: λ₂ = 0,5 · 1530/340 = 2,25 m.
Asos: λ₂/λ₁ = v₂/v₁.

en: The frequency does not change, therefore: $$\lambda_2=\lambda_1\frac{v_2}{v_1}=0.5\cdot\frac{1530}{340}=2.25\ \mathrm{m}$$

distractors_ru.E: λ умножена на скорость в воде

distractors_en.B: it was divided by the ratio of speeds
distractors_en.D: only the ratio of speeds was found
distractors_en.E: λ was multiplied by the speed in water

question_en: An ultrasonic echo-sounder signal returns after $1.8\ \mathrm{s}$. The speed of sound in water is $1500\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Find the depth of the sea ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_uz: Exolotdan yuborilgan ultratovush signali $1.8\ \mathrm{s}$ dan keyin qaytib keldi. Tovushning suvdagi tezligi $1500\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Dengiz chuqurligini toping ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_ru: Ультразвуковой сигнал эхолота вернулся через $1.8\ \mathrm{s}$. Скорость звука в воде $1500\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Найдите глубину моря ($\mathrm{m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Signal tubgacha borib-qaytadi: 2h = vt, h = 1500 · 1,8/2 = 1350 m.
Asos: aks-sado — 2d = vt.

en: The signal covers the depth twice: $$h=\frac{vt}{2}=\frac{1500\cdot1.8}{2}=1350\ \mathrm{m}$$

distractors.B: 2 ga bo'linmagan — yo'l ikki marta ekanligi unutilgan

distractors_ru.B: не разделено на 2 — забыт двойной путь

distractors_en.B: not divided by 2 — the double path was forgotten
distractors_en.C: the speed was divided by the time
distractors_en.D: it was divided by 4 instead of 2
distractors_en.E: 2v/t was computed — the formula is inverted

question_en: A marksman fires and hears the bullet hit the target after $2.5\ \mathrm{s}$. The bullet's speed is $510\ \mathrm{m/s}$ and the speed of sound is $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Find the distance to the target ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_uz: Mergan o'q uzdi va o'qning nishonga tekkan tovushini $2.5\ \mathrm{s}$ dan keyin eshitdi. O'q tezligi $510\ \mathrm{m/s}$, tovush tezligi $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Nishongacha masofani toping ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_ru: Стрелок выстрелил и услышал звук попадания пули в мишень через $2.5\ \mathrm{s}$. Скорость пули $510\ \mathrm{m/s}$, скорость звука $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Найдите расстояние до мишени ($\mathrm{m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. d/510 + d/340 = 2,5, ya'ni 5d/1020 = 2,5, d = 510 m.
Asos: umumiy vaqt — o'q va tovush vaqtlari yig'indisi.

uz: O'q borish va tovush qaytish vaqti: $$\frac{d}{510}+\frac{d}{340}=2.5$$
ru: Время полёта пули и возврата звука: $$\frac{d}{510}+\frac{d}{340}=2.5$$
en: Time of the bullet plus time of the sound: $$\frac{d}{510}+\frac{d}{340}=2.5$$

distractors.C: faqat tovush hisobga olinib, 2 ga bo'lingan

distractors_ru.C: учтён только звук и разделено на 2
distractors_ru.E: скорости сложены и умножены на время

distractors_en.A: only the motion of sound was taken into account
distractors_en.B: only the motion of the bullet was taken into account
distractors_en.C: only sound was used and the result was halved
distractors_en.E: the speeds were added and multiplied by the time

question_en: The amplitude of a sound wave increases $3$ times and its frequency decreases $2$ times. By what factor does the intensity increase?
question_uz: Tovush to'lqinining amplitudasi $3$ marta ortdi, chastotasi esa $2$ marta kamaydi. Intensivlik necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: Амплитуда звуковой волны увеличилась в $3$ раза, а частота уменьшилась в $2$ раза. Во сколько раз увеличится интенсивность?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. I ∼ A²ν²: 3² · (1/2)² = 9/4 = 2,25 marta ortadi.
Asos: intensivlik amplituda va chastota kvadratlariga proporsional.

distractors_en.D: the frequency was assumed to increase

question_en: Which quantities of a sound do not change when it passes from air into water? 1) speed of propagation; 2) wavelength; 3) frequency; 4) period of oscillation.
question_uz: Tovush havodan suvga o'tganda uning qaysi kattaliklari o'zgarmaydi? 1) tarqalish tezligi; 2) to'lqin uzunligi; 3) chastotasi; 4) tebranish davri.
question_ru: Какие величины звука не меняются при переходе из воздуха в воду? 1) скорость распространения; 2) длина волны; 3) частота; 4) период колебаний.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Chastotani manba belgilaydi, u (va T = 1/ν) o'zgarmaydi; tezlik va λ muhitga bog'liq.
Asos: muhit almashganda ν = const.

uz: Chastota va davr manbaga bog'liq: $$\nu_2=\nu_1,\quad T_2=T_1$$
ru: Частота и период зависят от источника: $$\nu_2=\nu_1,\quad T_2=T_1$$
Скорость и $\lambda$ зависят от среды: $$v_2\neq v_1,\quad \lambda_2\neq\lambda_1$$
en: Frequency and period depend on the source: $$\nu_2=\nu_1,\quad T_2=T_1$$
Speed and $\lambda$ depend on the medium: $$v_2\neq v_1,\quad \lambda_2\neq\lambda_1$$

rules.ru: При смене среды частота не меняется: $\nu_2=\nu_1$
rules.en: The frequency does not change with the medium: $\nu_2=\nu_1$

distractors.C: tezlik va to'lqin uzunligi aynan o'zgaradi

distractors_ru.C: меняются как раз скорость и длина волны
distractors_ru.D: длина волны меняется, а период нет
distractors_ru.E: в воде скорость звука больше, чем в воздухе

distractors_en.A: the period also stays the same: T = 1/ν
distractors_en.C: it is the speed and the wavelength that change
distractors_en.D: the wavelength changes, the period does not
distractors_en.E: the speed of sound in water is greater than in air

question_en: An observer in a car drives past a stationary siren. Which statements are true? 1) While approaching, the pitch sounds higher. 2) While moving away, the pitch sounds lower. 3) The frequency emitted by the siren changes. 4) The effect occurs only when the source moves.
question_uz: Qo'zg'almas sirena yonidan avtomobildagi kuzatuvchi o'tib ketdi. Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Yaqinlashayotganda ohang balandroq eshitiladi. 2) Uzoqlashayotganda ohang pastroq eshitiladi. 3) Sirena chiqarayotgan chastota o'zgaradi. 4) Effekt faqat manba harakatlanganda kuzatiladi.
question_ru: Наблюдатель в автомобиле проехал мимо неподвижной сирены. Какие утверждения верны? 1) При приближении тон слышен выше. 2) При удалении тон слышен ниже. 3) Частота, излучаемая сиреной, меняется. 4) Эффект наблюдается только при движении источника.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Dopler effekti kuzatuvchi harakatida ham bor: yaqinlashganda ohang baland, uzoqlashganda past; manba chastotasi o'zgarmaydi.
Asos: Dopler effekti.

en: 3 is false: the source frequency does not change.
4 is false: motion of the observer is enough.

rules.ru: При сближении тон выше, при удалении ниже
rules.en: Approaching: higher pitch; receding: lower pitch

distractors.D: effekt kuzatuvchi harakatlanganda ham bor — 4 noto'g'ri

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 2 тоже верно: при удалении тон ниже
distractors_ru.D: эффект есть и при движении наблюдателя — 4 неверно

distractors_en.A: statement 2 is also true: the pitch drops when receding
distractors_en.B: the siren's frequency does not change, so 3 is false
distractors_en.D: the effect also occurs when the observer moves, so 4 is false
distractors_en.E: 3 and 4 are false, while 1 and 2 are true

question_en: Which of the following mechanical waves are ultrasound? 1) $0.8\ \mathrm{MHz}$; 2) $12\ \mathrm{kHz}$; 3) $5\ \mathrm{Hz}$; 4) $45\ \mathrm{kHz}$.
question_ru: Какие из следующих механических волн являются ультразвуком? 1) $0.8\ \mathrm{MHz}$; 2) $12\ \mathrm{kHz}$; 3) $5\ \mathrm{Hz}$; 4) $45\ \mathrm{kHz}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Ultratovush — 20 kHz dan yuqori: 0,8 MHz = 800 kHz va 45 kHz; 12 kHz eshitiladi, 5 Hz — infratovush.
Asos: 16 Hz < ν < 20 kHz — tovush.

distractors.C: 12 kHz — eshitiladigan tovush, 0,8 MHz esa ultratovush

distractors_ru.C: 12 kHz — слышимый звук, а 0,8 MHz — ультразвук

distractors_en.C: 12 kHz is audible, while 0.8 MHz is ultrasound
distractors_en.E: 12 kHz lies in the audible range

question_en: One end of a steel rail is struck with a hammer. A person at the other end hears two sounds $2.1\ \mathrm{s}$ apart. The speed of sound is $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$ in air and $5100\ \mathrm{m/s}$ in steel. Find the length of the rail ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_uz: Po'lat relsning bir uchiga bolg'a bilan urildi. Ikkinchi uchidagi odam ikki tovushni $2.1\ \mathrm{s}$ farq bilan eshitdi. Tovush tezligi havoda $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$, po'latda $5100\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Rels uzunligini toping ($\mathrm{m}$).
question_ru: По одному концу стального рельса ударили молотком. Человек у другого конца услышал два звука с разницей $2.1\ \mathrm{s}$. Скорость звука в воздухе $340\ \mathrm{m/s}$, в стали $5100\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Найдите длину рельса ($\mathrm{m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. L/340 − L/5100 = 2,1, ya'ni 14L/5100 = 2,1, L = 765 m.
Asos: vaqtlar farqi Δt = L/v₁ − L/v₂.

uz: Havodagi va po'latdagi tovush vaqtlari farqi: $$\frac{L}{340}-\frac{L}{5100}=2.1$$
ru: Разность времён звука в воздухе и в стали: $$\frac{L}{340}-\frac{L}{5100}=2.1$$
en: Difference of the times in air and in steel: $$\frac{L}{340}-\frac{L}{5100}=2.1$$

distractors_ru.C: результат разделён на 2, как для эха

distractors_en.A: only the sound in air was used: 340 · 2.1
distractors_en.B: only the sound in steel was used: 5100 · 2.1
distractors_en.C: the result was halved as for an echo
distractors_en.E: the times were added instead of subtracted

question_en: A string vibrates at $40\ \mathrm{Hz}$ and a standing wave forms on it. The distance between the $1$st and $4$th nodes is $0.6\ \mathrm{m}$. Find the speed of waves on the string ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_uz: Ip $40\ \mathrm{Hz}$ chastota bilan tebranib, unda turg'un to'lqin hosil bo'ldi. $1$-tugun va $4$-tugun orasidagi masofa $0.6\ \mathrm{m}$. Ipdagi to'lqinlar tezligini toping ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_ru: Нить колеблется с частотой $40\ \mathrm{Hz}$, и в ней образовалась стоячая волна. Расстояние между $1$-м и $4$-м узлами $0.6\ \mathrm{m}$. Найдите скорость волн в нити ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. 3 · λ/2 = 0,6 m, λ = 0,4 m; v = λν = 0,4 · 40 = 16 m/s.
Asos: qo'shni tugunlar orasi λ/2, v = λν.

distractors.A: qo'shni tugunlar orasi λ deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: расстояние между соседними узлами взято λ

distractors_en.A: the distance between neighbouring nodes was taken as λ
distractors_en.B: the whole distance was taken as λ
distractors_en.D: λ was divided by the frequency
